name: Sato Foods Industries Co., Ltd.
summary: Sato Foods Industries Co., Ltd. produces and sells powdered alcohol, natural seasonings and extracts of tea and plants in Japan and internationally. The powdered alcohol goes into snacks, drinks, soups, processed seafood, prepared meals and pickles, and the plant extracts are used in coffee extracts and powders made from juice or vegetables. It dates from 1950 and has its head office in Komaki, Japan.
